logic_group.name: YAJL JSON streaming parser
logic_group.description: The core YAJL parsing engine provides a stream-oriented JSON parser. The process involves allocating a parser handle with optional configurations for comment support and UTF-8 validation, followed by feeding JSON data chunks into the parser. The internal logic employs a state-machine-based approach and a lexer to efficiently tokenize and decode JSON input, triggering user-defined callbacks for various JSON elements. The parser handles complex tasks such as UTF-8 validation, string escape sequence decoding, and number parsing.
